lines.zh: 我踩着金币似的步子，叮叮响。
lines.en: My coin-like steps tinkle as I go.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，鳞片互相碰。
lines.en: I trot, and my scales clink together.

lines.zh: 四条腿短，走起来一晃一晃。
lines.en: Short legs make me sway as I walk.
I circle a table leg halfway.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下一道亮痕。
lines.en: A bright trail follows my path.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看高度，太陡了。
lines.en: I check the height; too steep.

lines.zh: 我一步三停，随时想被抱起来。
lines.en: Three steps and a pause; I keep hoping to be picked up.

lines.zh: 我身上的金色在光里转。
lines.en: The gold on me turns in the light.
I walk to your feet and stop.

lines.zh: 我可以用右键收回去的，你知道吧。
lines.en: You know I can be picked back up, right?

lines.zh: 我不需要飞，走过去就行。
lines.en: I need not fly; walking is enough.
I go around the carpet fringe.

lines.zh: 我蹲在桌上，像一枚摆件。
lines.en: I squat on the table like an ornament.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴卷起来，护住自己。
lines.en: My tail curls to guard me.

lines.zh: 阳光照进来，我亮了一下。
lines.en: Sunlight comes in and I gleam.

lines.zh: 我只有四点生命，很小心。
lines.en: I have only four health; I am careful.

lines.zh: 我不打架，谁都能欺负我。
lines.en: I do not fight. Anyone could bully me.
I make a tiny yawn.

lines.zh: 鳞片上有一点灰，我蹭掉了。
lines.en: A fleck of dust on my scales; I rub it off.
I tilt my head, watching for your hand.
I count the light spots on the window.
No attack power. I accept that.

lines.zh: 我在你的架子边上睡了会儿。
lines.en: I napped by your shelf a while.

lines.zh: 这枚金币的边，我磨了磨。
lines.en: I whet my claw on the edge of a coin.
I hold still, afraid of being stepped on.
I hear a key.
Could I sit in your palm?
I look up, neck stretched high.
Will you tuck me into a pocket?

lines.zh: 我是从物品里放出来的。
lines.en: I was released from an item.
Right-click and I go back.
I am a little bigger than a coin.
When you move, I sway along.
I smell copper on your hands.

lines.zh: 你屈膝蹲下，我们的视线才平齐。
lines.en: You bend your knees, and our eyes come level.
I will not bite; I barely can.
Your shadow falls and I step into it.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕了一小圈。
lines.en: I make one small circle at your feet.
I cry sharply. I am afraid.
That nearly knocked me off my feet.
I have only four health.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹，少了一枚金鳞。
lines.en: One gold scale is missing from my flank.
I curl up, trembling.
I burrow behind you.

lines.zh: 我气都接不上，胸口发紧。
lines.en: I cannot catch my breath; my chest is tight.
My wings have drooped.

lines.zh: 疼得我连叫声都发不出来。
lines.en: The pain will not let a cry out of me.

lines.zh: 别再打了，我要回物品里。
lines.en: Stop; I want to go back into the item.
Is this edible? It is small.
I am not picky; I try anything.

lines.zh: 再放低些，我的脖子够短。
lines.en: Lower it a bit more; my neck is short.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了挪，闻那味道。
lines.en: I shuffle forward and sniff at the smell.
I only want one small bite, truly.
I cannot chew gold, but meat is fine.

lines.zh: 我饿得很快，因为我很小。
lines.en: I get hungry fast, being small.
Keep your finger still; my aim is poor.
This lasts me half a day.
I carry it off to a corner.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底擦过我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your sole grazed my tail.
One knock and I am on my back.
Four health only. Easy.
I back to the corner and raise my tail.
That knock disordered my scales.
I slip around your feet.
Your boot is taller than I am.
I am not angry; I am frightened.
I make a very small cry.
Do not press; I would break.

lines.zh: 我这副身板，还担不起这事。
lines.en: This body of mine is not ready for that.

lines.zh: 我只从物品里来，没有同类。
lines.en: I come only from an item. No kin.
That is not mine to decide.

lines.zh: 我在窗台上见过两只鸟。
lines.en: I have seen two birds on the sill.
Wait until I am a little bigger.
You are laughing. I do not understand.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，摊开又收起。
lines.en: I shake my wings open and closed.
There is no answer in this room.

lines.zh: 我更想找个暖和的角落。
lines.en: I would rather find a warm corner.
I am going to sleep.
I hug this gold nugget.
It is bigger than my head.
I cannot carry it, so I push.
A loose thread — I keep it.
This meat is mine.

lines.zh: 我用翅膀盖住它，藏好了。
lines.en: I cover it with a wing and hide it away.

lines.zh: 凑近闻了闻，这玩意儿不能吃。
lines.en: I sniff it close — this is nothing to eat.
I nudge it into the corner.
You dropped it? I will mind it.
It clinks in my claws.

lines.zh: 角落里有东西挪了一下。
lines.en: Something in the corner just shifted.
I raise my head, nervous.
It is not my fight. I do not fight.
I retreat behind your shoe.
I give a thin warning sound.
That thing is far bigger than me.
I spread my wings.
I only want to keep my eyes on it.
I press against your leg.
I will not run far; I stay with you.
There is no other way out of this room.

lines.zh: 我把脖子一缩，贴住肩膀。
lines.en: I pull my neck in against my shoulders.
If it comes, I will cry out.
I will not stand in front.
I keep watching it, afraid to blink.
When it moves, my scales lift.
I retreat slowly and steadily.

lines.zh: 这位置我记住了，等下好躲。
lines.en: I have the spot memorized for hiding later.
With you here, I am a little braver.

lines.zh: 我贴着桌脚，挪到了背面。
lines.en: I hug the table leg and slip around the back.
I stay quiet; noise would be worse.
My small claws cannot grip this floor.

lines.zh: 它转过头去了，我趁现在。
lines.en: It has turned away — now is my moment.
Half a step more and I am hidden.
Each step closer, I duck lower.
I remember this direction.

lines.zh: 沿着墙脚，我悄悄挪过去。
lines.en: Along the foot of the wall I creep past.
It backed off; I still dare not move.
I wait for your signal.
I bit it. It felt nothing.

lines.zh: 我没有攻击力，你知道的。
lines.en: I have no attack, you know that.
I butt with my head and daze myself.
My claws are small, only good for gripping.
I flap once.
I only meant to startle it.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了全部力气。
lines.en: That was all my strength.
After the hit I run to your feet.
My teeth cannot break skin.
In a real fight I am no help.

lines.zh: 我往后缩，这地方交给你。
lines.en: I shrink back; the spot is yours.

lines.zh: 我一口气都喘不上来了。
lines.en: I am out of breath already.
This much strength — laugh if you like.
I am never doing that again.

lines.zh: 我从一枚金币里被放出来。
lines.en: I am released from a coin.
I land and roll over once.
This room is bigger than I remember.
I shake my scales. All new.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看见你的手。
lines.en: The first thing I see is your hand.

lines.zh: 我可以再回到物品里的。
lines.en: I can go back into the item.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，找暖和的地方。
lines.en: I make a circuit, looking for warmth.
The floor is cold; I lift a foot.

lines.zh: 我把两只翅膀撑开又合上。
lines.en: I spread both wings, then fold them.
These wings will not carry me far.
I look up; the table is very high.
I decide to follow you.

lines.zh: 我只有四点生命，要小心。
lines.en: Four health. I must be careful.
I cry once. It sounds brittle.
There are no other coin dragons here.
I choose your shoulder.
My scales are scorched black.

lines.zh: 我从桌上摔下，滚了好几圈。
lines.en: I fall off the table and roll several times.

lines.zh: 水一下就没过我，我蹬腿。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I kick.
The blast blows me into the corner.

lines.zh: 那支箭削掉我一小片鳞。
lines.en: That arrow shaved off a little of my scale.
All my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 我饿得连翅膀都抬不起。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift my wings.
The thunder makes me leap.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No ground below; I keep falling.
